title: 2.2 patch notes are out
content: CD Projekt dropped a new patch with fixes for the police AI and a bunch of vehicle changes. Worth a reinstall if you stopped playing a while ago.
author: robert

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Finally! The cops were so broken before.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Does it fix the crash in the Afterlife? Mine kept dying there.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It does for me. I did a full run last week and no crashes at all, which would have been unthinkable at launch.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Also the new car handling feels a lot better, less like driving a shopping cart.

title: Which build are you running for a second playthrough?
content: I finished my first run as a netrunner and I'm thinking of going full melee with Mantis Blades next. Anyone tried a hybrid build that actually works? I don't want to be useless in a boss fight.
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Mantis Blades with a bit of Reflexes is really fun. Dashing through enemies never gets old.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I tried a hybrid and it felt like I wasn't good at anything. Pick one and commit.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Gorilla Arms for the early game, then swap once you have the cash. Super satisfying.

title: Is Phantom Liberty worth it?
content: I liked the base game but I'm not sure I want to dive back into Night City for more hours. Does the expansion add enough to justify buying it, or is it more of the same?
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It's honestly better than the base game story-wise. The spy thriller vibe is great.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Dogtown is a really different feel from the rest of the city, more tense and more dangerous.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Buy it on sale if you're unsure, but you will probably not regret it.

title: The soundtrack deserves more love
content: I keep listening to the in-game radio stations while working. Between the rock, the synthwave and the weird talk shows, it's one of the best soundtracks I've heard in years. What are your favorite stations?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Radio Pebkac is underrated. Short songs but they all go hard.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Samurai tracks make every drive feel like a music video.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I only listen to the Spanish-language station when I need to concentrate. No idea why it works for me.

title: New Witcher game confirmed to be in early development
content: CD Projekt has confirmed that the next big Witcher title is moving through its early development stages, with a new story that will not follow Geralt directly. Details are scarce, but the studio promised it will take its time.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Not following Geralt is a bold move. I'm nervous but curious.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Honestly it makes sense. His story felt complete after Blood and Wine.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: As long as the writing stays at the same level I'm in. That's what made Witcher 3 special.

title: Is Gwent still worth playing?
content: I went back to the standalone Gwent after years and it feels completely different from the minigame in Witcher 3. Is anyone still playing it? I can't decide if it's worth getting back into the ranked ladder.
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The Witcher 3 version was much more relaxed. The standalone one is a proper competitive card game now.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I played for a few weeks and stopped. Too many things to learn at once.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Honestly I just play it in Witcher 3 whenever I replay it. Best minigame ever put in an RPG.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Fair enough, I'll go back to the Witcher 3 one, then.

title: Blood and Wine is the best DLC ever made
content: I just finished Toussaint and I'm still amazed at how much content they put into an expansion. New map, new characters, great story and a proper goodbye to Geralt. Other studios should take notes.
author: alvaro

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The Beauclair intro is the most beautiful place in any RPG. I still stop and look at it.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The Tesham Mutna quest line is peak storytelling for me.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Elden Ring's Shadow of the Erdtree is the only one that comes close.

title: Which Witcher 3 ending did you get? (spoilers)
content: I got the good ending with Ciri becoming a witcher and I cried more than I'd like to admit. Did you get a different one? I'm curious about the choices that led you there.
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: I accidentally got the bad one. I was too focused on side quests and ignored her for a long time.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Good ending too. Being kind to her in the small moments really pays off.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I'm doing a second run just to see what each ending looks like. No regrets about the first one, though.

title: Best crop order for year one?
content: Just started a new farm and I keep going back and forth between strawberries and cauliflower for spring. What do you all prioritize?
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Strawberries from the Egg Festival, no question. Cauliflower is a trap early on.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I go for potatoes first and use the cash for strawberries. Slower start, but safer.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Also don't forget to save some money for the greenhouse repair. It makes the whole year easier.

title: Finally finished the Community Center after 40 hours
content: It took me longer than I would like to admit, mostly because of the fish bundle. Anyone else almost quit because of the legendary fish? I was about to give up when I got the Glacierfish.
author: alvaro

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The fish bundle is the real final boss of Stardew.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Congrats! Wait until you start doing the Perfection tracker, that's where the real pain begins.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I still haven't gotten the Legend. Been trying for three seasons.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Bring food that boosts your fishing level and be patient. It took me about 10 tries.

title: Who did you marry in your first save?
content: I went with Abigail because of the mines and the video games, but I've heard everyone has a great story. I'm curious about who you chose and why, and whether anyone regrets it.
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Sebastian. The rainy days with him are the cosiest part of the whole game.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Leah! I love her cabin and her art. I had a big grin the whole time during the heart events.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Never married in the first save, I was too busy with the farm. Just married Penny in the second one.

title: Is co-op worth it for a first playthrough?
content: A friend wants to start a shared farm with me, but I've never played the game. Will I miss anything by starting in multiplayer, or is it better to learn the basics on my own first?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Do it together! We split the work and it's so much more relaxed.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: My only advice is to agree on who handles money, because arguments about the shared wallet are real.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Start in co-op, and if you like it, make a solo farm later. You'll appreciate the differences.

title: Halo Infinite: what is the future of the campaign?
content: With the multiplayer getting regular updates, I wonder if 343 will ever add more campaign content. The open-world part had so much potential and the ending left a lot of questions. Anyone have news?
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The Zeta Halo setting was great but the story felt rushed in the final part.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I would take a proper expansion over another battle pass any day.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I think they're focused on whatever comes next. Infinite feels like a closed chapter now.

title: Hot take: Halo 3 is still the best multiplayer
content: I replayed some Halo 3 matches last night and nothing beats the feel of those maps and the weapon balance. Modern shooters have too many things going on at once. Change my mind.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Valhalla and Guardian are perfect maps. Nobody makes them like that anymore.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Halo 2 had better tricks and more skill gap, but I get your point.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I started with Reach, so for me the Reach loadouts will always be the best, even if people disagree.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Reach is underrated for sure. The Anniversary version is hard to find these days though.

title: Master Chief Collection on PC: still the best way to play?
content: I want to play the whole saga in order, and the Master Chief Collection seems the obvious option. Is it stable now? I remember it having a lot of problems at launch.
author: alvaro

comments.author: robert
comments.text: It's in much better shape now. Halo 2 Anniversary graphics are still a treat.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Use the campaign mode in order of release, not chronological. The storytelling makes more sense that way.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Just be ready for a bit of waiting in the multiplayer matchmaking, depending on the playlist.

title: Favorite Halo weapon of all time?
content: Energy sword, Battle Rifle, Needler, Gravity Hammer... There are so many iconic ones. Mine is the Battle Rifle: nothing feels as good as landing a perfect three-burst headshot.
author: martin

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Energy sword, because the lunge makes you feel invincible for 2 seconds.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The Needler. Nothing beats the feeling of pink crystals going off in a group of enemies.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Plasma pistol overcharge into a headshot is such an underrated combo.

title: Warzone or the main campaign: what do you actually play?
content: I buy every game for the campaign, but my friends only care about Warzone. Lately I've been feeling like I'm the last person who plays the single-player mode. Is anyone else in the same boat?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The campaign is a nice two-night weekend thing, but I spend hundreds of hours in multiplayer.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Same here! The campaigns are surprisingly well made. Mission design is great.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I only touch Warzone if my friends are online. Playing solo is a bit lonely.

title: Modern Warfare 2 campaign still holds up
content: I replayed the original Modern Warfare 2 campaign yesterday. The pacing, the missions and the music are still great after all these years. No Russian is as shocking as I remember it.
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Wolverines! is still one of my favorite missions ever. Defending the suburbs just feels amazing.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The story is pure action movie nonsense, but it works for me.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Honestly the first Modern Warfare is even better. Death from Above is perfect.

title: Why do the yearly releases feel so similar?
content: Every year there is a new Call of Duty and the changes seem minimal: new maps, new weapons, new cosmetics. I get that people like the formula, but do you ever feel tired of it?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: I skip every other year. It makes the new release feel more fresh.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The change from one game to another is small, but I like having a reason to play with friends.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: If the movement system keeps changing I'll keep buying. I'd stop if it became another copy of last year.

title: Zombies is the real reason I still buy the game
content: I don't care about ranked or the campaign, I just want a night of Zombies with friends and a few easter eggs to figure out. Anyone else play only that mode?
author: daniel

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Black Ops 3 Zombies was peak. Shadows of Evil still has my favorite easter egg.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: We spent an entire weekend trying to finish one easter egg and had a blast.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Round 30 with random teammates is a stress test for any friendship.

title: Show off your biggest build
content: I just finished a medieval castle that took me almost three weeks. It has a working drawbridge and a full village around it. What is the biggest thing you've ever built?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Sounds amazing! My biggest build was a replica of my high school, and it took forever.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: A giant pirate ship that now sits in the middle of a desert. No idea why I built it there.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: A spawn city with a metro line. The redstone was the most painful part.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: A metro line is next level, I need to see it.

title: Survival server tips: how do you avoid griefers?
content: My friends and I just opened a small survival server and I'm worried about someone destroying our builds. Any advice about plugins or rules to prevent that?
author: daniel

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Use a claim plugin like GriefPrevention. It lets everyone protect their area.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: A whitelist is the simplest option. Only the people you know can join.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Also keep backups. If something goes wrong you can restore it in a couple of minutes.

title: Redstone beginner: automatic farm that actually works
content: I want to build a simple automatic wheat farm, but every tutorial I find uses a different design. Which is the easiest one that works well in survival without too many materials?
author: robert

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: A water stream with villagers and a hopper is easy and efficient for a starter farm.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Observers plus pistons are the best trick for crops that grow vertically, like sugar cane.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Start small and understand each piece. Copying a design without knowing how it works makes it hard to fix.

title: Best seed for a village next to a mountain?
content: I'm starting a new world and I want a good place for my base: a village nearby, mountains to explore and some caves close to the surface. Does anyone have a seed they love?
author: martin

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I don't remember any seed numbers, but try creating a few worlds and checking the spawn. It's quick and fun.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Use a seed map tool online to preview the terrain without loading the world.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Mountains plus a village is easy to find in the recent versions. The new terrain generation is amazing.

title: Just beat The Devil after 200 tries
content: I can't believe I finally did it. I almost threw the controller a few times, but the feeling when the final hit landed was incredible. Cuphead is the most rewarding game I've played.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Congrats! The last phase is brutal. Good job staying calm.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: 200 tries is nothing, I think I was near 300 for King Dice alone.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Did you use the Smoke Bomb or stay with the Spread? I never found a loadout I liked for that fight.

title: Is The Delicious Last Course harder than the base game?
content: I'm thinking about buying the DLC, but I'm afraid it will be too much for me. Is the difficulty similar, or do the new bosses go beyond what the base game asks?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Similar difficulty overall, but a couple of bosses are the best in the whole game.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Chalice is a great new character. The extra jump makes the platforming fights much easier.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Buy it. Even if you die a lot, the new music alone is worth the price.

title: The art style is stunning
content: I read that the whole game was hand-drawn like old cartoons from the 1930s, and you can really feel it. The animations, the colors, the film grain... Nothing else looks like it.
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The boss intros look like they came straight out of an old Betty Boop episode.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The jazz soundtrack is the other half of the magic. They fit each other perfectly.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: It is the best example of a game where visual identity matters more than technical power.

title: Co-op Cuphead is a friendship test
content: My brother and I tried to finish the game together and we have yelled at each other more than ever. In the end we did it though. Anyone else think co-op is harder than playing alone?
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: The screen gets so full of bullets that you lose track of yourself, let alone your partner.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Co-op is good because you can revive each other, but the revive mechanic is a trap sometimes.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: My girlfriend and I did it in a week. We communicated well and did not scream. Barely.

title: Malenia is a skill check I'm not ready for
content: I've been stuck on Malenia for two days. The waterfowl dance keeps killing me no matter how many times I dodge. Do I need to level up, or is it just a pattern thing?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Dodge toward her, not away. It sounds crazy, but it works with the waterfowl dance.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I used spirit ashes and it helped a lot to split her aggro. Don't feel bad about it.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: It took me about 60 tries. Take a break, come back the next day, and it clicks.

title: Shadow of the Erdtree: is it worth the difficulty?
content: I've heard the expansion is much harder than the base game, even for experienced players. I finished Elden Ring with a strong build and I'm wondering if I'm going to get stomped.
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It's hard, but in the good sense. The new areas are among the best in any Souls game.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Collect the Scadutree Fragments early. They make a huge difference and are the main way to get stronger.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Be ready to feel weak for a few hours. After that it gets better.

title: Best build for a first playthrough?
content: I'm new to this genre and I don't want to ruin my first run with a bad build. I've seen advice to go Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence. What would you recommend for someone who doesn't know the game?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Go with a Strength build and a good weapon. It's forgiving and helps you learn the bosses.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Mage is the easiest way to learn the game, because you can fight from a distance.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Don't spend too much time on the build. Try everything for a few hours and respec later with the Rebirth.

title: Torrent ruined all other open-world games for me
content: Having a horse that you can summon anywhere and that jumps like a mountain goat is the best thing ever. Why can't every game have this? Going back to other games feels so slow.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The double jump alone makes exploration feel great.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: RDR2's horse is more realistic, but Torrent is much more fun to use.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Fighting from horseback in the open fields is great. Dragons were a lot less scary on Torrent.

title: Dark Souls 1 or 3: which one is better?
content: I started with Dark Souls 3 and loved it, but my friends keep saying the first one is a masterpiece because of the world design. I'm thinking about playing it. Is it worth it?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The first one has the best level design in the series. The way the world loops back on itself is amazing.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: DS3 is faster and the bosses are better. DS1 is the one that feels more like an adventure.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Play DS1 after DS3 and appreciate its flaws. You will love it anyway.

title: Anor Londo archers: still the worst
content: Years later, I still hate the Anor Londo archers. It doesn't matter how many times I do this part, they find a way to hit me with an arrow when I'm about to light the bonfire.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The solution is to take the roof and go slowly. Or accept death once or twice.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The silver knights are the real problem if you ask me.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I just rush past them with a good shield and a prayer.

title: Tips for a total beginner
content: I just bought Dark Souls Remastered and I'm scared. I've heard it is brutal and I don't want to quit after a few hours. Any advice to enjoy the first steps?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Use a shield, be patient and don't fight everything. Running past enemies is often the right answer.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Don't be afraid to look for help when you get stuck. It isn't cheating, it's part of the culture.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Take the Master Key as a gift. It opens many places and gives you more options.

title: Solaire is the best character in the series
content: A friendly knight who just wants to find his sun and who helps you in the hardest fights. Why is such a simple character so memorable? Praise the sun!
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: He is the emotional heart of the first game. His fate makes me sad every time.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Siegmeyer is a close second. Same optimism, different personality.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I still summon him in every boss fight, even if I don't need to. It feels wrong not to.

topic: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Weapon durability: love it or hate it?
content: I spent a lot of time trying to find the best weapon only for it to break after a few fights. Some people say it adds challenge and others find it annoying. What's your opinion?
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: At first I hated it, but it forced me to use different tools and tactics. Now I miss it in other games.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It makes sense with the game's survival feeling, but it is frustrating when a legendary weapon breaks.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I wish there was a repair option, even an expensive one. Just for the good stuff.

topic: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Favorite shrine puzzle?
content: There are so many shrines that it's hard to choose a favorite. Mine is the one where you have to use the motion controls to balance a platform. Simple but clever. What is yours?
author: alvaro

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The ones where you solve them with a completely unexpected solution are the best.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Any shrine that makes me say 'wait, I can do that?' is my favorite.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I love the ones with the magnetism rune. So many ways to cheat the puzzle.

topic: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Spent 3 hours just riding horses and cooking
content: I got lost looking for the next shrine and ended up doing nothing for the whole evening: taming horses, collecting ingredients and cooking meals. Best gaming session in months.
author: daniel

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: That is exactly how the game wants you to play. No pressure at all.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The cooking sounds should be in an ASMR video.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The first time I got to the top of a mountain just to glide down it was the same. No quest, just fun.

topic: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Tears of the Kingdom or Breath of the Wild?
content: I love both, but I can't decide which one I prefer. Tears of the Kingdom has more creativity, but Breath of the Wild has a sense of discovery that is hard to repeat. Which one would you pick?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Tears of the Kingdom, because building things with Ultrahand is a dream come true.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Breath of the Wild. The first time you leave the Great Plateau is magical.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Both are great, but Tears of the Kingdom feels a bit overwhelming. I took a lot more time to finish it.

title: Silksong or Hollow Knight first?
content: My friend wants me to play Silksong, but I've never played the original game. Should I start with Hollow Knight, or can I jump straight into the sequel?
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Play Hollow Knight first. The sequel is good but it makes more sense when you know the world.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: You can start with Silksong and be fine, but I think you will enjoy it more with the original first.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Hollow Knight is shorter than people think. Just do it.

title: The Path of Pain: was it worth it?
content: I just finished the Path of Pain after what felt like a hundred attempts. The reward is a cosmetic thing, but the satisfaction is huge. Did you also go for it, or did you skip it?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I skipped it. I have a limit for frustration and it's lower than yours.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I did it, and I still have nightmares about those saw blades.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: It's the best platforming challenge in the game, I think. Well done!

title: Best charm combo for the early game
content: I just got the Mothwing Cloak and I'm trying to find a good charm combination. Right now I'm using Quick Slash with Longnail, but I'm not sure it's the best option. What do you recommend?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Quick Focus and Lifeblood Heart are great for beginners. Healing faster saves a lot of runs.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Wayward Compass is the one I would never take off. Getting lost in this game is real.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Try Shaman Stone with your spells. It makes the magic feel way more powerful.

title: Hornet fight: any tips?
content: I've been trying the first Hornet fight in Greenpath for a while and I can't figure out how to beat her. Her moves are so fast. How do you deal with her needle throws?
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Learn the sound of each attack. The audio cues are more useful than the visual ones.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Stay close to her and attack when she lands. Running away makes it harder.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Just keep trying. The second time I fought her I won easily, and I didn't change anything.

title: Which weapon do you main?
content: I started with the Stygian Blade, but I've been using the Twin Fists for a while and I love them. Which weapon do you prefer, and which one would you recommend to a beginner?
author: alvaro

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The Shield of Chaos. The throw and block combo is so good.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Stygian Blade is perfect for beginners. Simple and effective.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The Heart-Seeking Bow, I will never go back to melee. Staying at a distance is my style.

title: The writing and voice acting are unreal
content: What I like most about Hades is that dying is part of the story. Every time you return to the House the characters react to what happened. I've never seen a game use repetition this well.
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Every death gives you new dialogue. It makes failing feel like progress.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Zagreus' voice actor is amazing. He gives so much personality to every line.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The way they handle relationships is really good. I wanted to get every character to like me.

title: Finally escaped after 40 runs
content: After all this time I made it out of Tartarus, and I haven't even reached the surface yet. This game has the best sense of progress. I feel stronger even when I lose.
author: daniel

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Wait until you reach the surface. The story gets much more interesting.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: The Mirror upgrades are a big help. Don't forget to spend your Darkness.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: 40 runs is a good number. I needed 25 and I thought I was slow.

title: Hades 2 vs Hades: which is better?
content: I've played both for many hours and I still can't decide which one I prefer. The sequel has more variety, but the first game has a tighter story. What do you think?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Hades 2 has better combat and magic. The first game has the better characters.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I like Melinoe more as a protagonist than Zagreus. Fight me.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I think the original is more focused. The sequel is bigger but loses a bit of that magic.

title: Honour Mode is brutal
content: I started a Honour Mode run with a friend and we've already lost twice. One mistake and the whole run is gone. Is it worth continuing, or should we go back to a normal difficulty?
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Save the game constantly, even if the game only has one save. Make backups manually.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Prepare for every fight. Scouting and positioning matter more than anything else.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Do it in a normal run first, so you know the encounters. Honour Mode is much more fun that way.

title: Which companion is your favorite?
content: I can't decide between Shadowheart and Karlach. Both have great stories, but Karlach is just a sweetheart. Who do you think has the best personality in the game?
author: daniel

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Karlach all the way. Her story broke my heart and made me smile at the same time.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Astarion, because his arc is so well written and changes with your choices.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Lae'zel. Her fierce attitude makes every conversation more fun.

title: How long did your first playthrough take?
content: I'm at 120 hours and I'm still in Act 2. I want to do everything and talk to everyone, but I'm starting to wonder if I'll ever finish. How long did it take you?
author: robert

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: About 150 hours, and I still missed a lot of content.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Around 100, but I rushed Act 3 because I wanted to see how it ended.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Don't worry about time. This game is made to be explored slowly.

title: Is an evil playthrough worth it?
content: I usually play good characters, but I've heard the evil route has a lot of unique content. Do you lose a lot by making selfish choices, or does the game reward it well?
author: alvaro

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It rewards you in a surprising way. Some scenes are only available if you're terrible.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Dark Urge is a great origin for that. The writing for it is excellent.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I tried and couldn't keep it up. I felt too guilty after every bad choice.

title: RDR2's ending still hits hard
content: It's been years since I finished Red Dead Redemption 2 and I still think about the ending. The way it builds up to those last moments is incredible. No spoilers, but you know what I mean.
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The mountain scene at the end is one of the most powerful moments in any game.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I couldn't play for a few days after I finished it. It was too much.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The epilogue made me feel something for a character I didn't expect to care about.

title: The horse bonding system is underrated
content: I love that the more you ride your horse, the better it responds to you. It reacts to your commands faster and stays calm in dangerous situations. It makes you care about it for real.
author: alvaro

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I almost cried when mine died. I had spent so much time taking care of it.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Brushing the horse after a long ride makes me feel like a real cowboy.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The detail in the animations is insane. The way the horse moves is incredible.

title: Online or story mode?
content: I've spent more than 300 hours in the story mode and I've barely touched online. Is it worth trying? Or is it better to keep the memory of the game as it is?
author: daniel

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Online has some fun roles like Trader and Bounty Hunter, but it doesn't match the story at all.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I'd say try it for a weekend. If you don't like it, you haven't lost anything.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Story mode is the main attraction. Online is more for hanging out with friends.

title: Hot take: John Marston is a better protagonist than Arthur
content: Arthur is great, but I think John's story in the first game is more focused and has a stronger sense of direction. His struggle to leave his past behind is more compelling to me.
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Arthur's journey is deeper for me. His change over the game is much bigger.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I think you can't compare them. They are in different stages of the same story.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Both of them are great. RDR1 deserves a modern remake so more people could play it.

title: GTA VI official 2nd trailer
content: Rockstar Games has released the official second trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, showcasing new gameplay footage, story elements, and features of the highly anticipated game.
author: robert

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The lighting alone is insane. Vice City at sunset looks better than most movies.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Did anyone else notice the radio snippet near the end?

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: I'll believe it when I have the disc in my hands. Rockstar delays everything, but wow.

title: GTA VI release date rumors
content: Rumors are swirling about the potential release date for Grand Theft Auto VI, with speculation about the launch window changing every few weeks. Fans are eagerly awaiting official confirmation from Rockstar Games.
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Every month there is a new 'insider' with a different date. I'm ignoring all of them until Rockstar says something.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Same. My bet is they announce it with a short teaser and nothing else.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: As long as it ships polished I don't mind waiting. Cyberpunk taught me that lesson.

title: GTA VI map details
content: New details about the map of Grand Theft Auto VI have emerged, suggesting a vast and diverse open world that includes multiple cities and rural areas, offering players a rich and immersive gaming experience.
author: martin

title: GTA VI Massive leak
content: A massive leak has revealed extensive details about Grand Theft Auto VI, including character information, gameplay mechanics, and storyline elements. The leak has sparked significant discussion among fans eagerly anticipating the game's release.
author: martin

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I can't wait to play GTA VI!

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Yeah, I'm excited too!

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I hope the release date rumors are true!

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Is this leak even real? Half the leaks I've seen are fan-made and look convincing until you check the details.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The map looks legit to me. The road layout matches some of the shots from the trailers.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Same, but I'd wait for Rockstar to confirm anything. They usually take leaks down fast, so it's a bit weird that this one is still up.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Or they just don't care anymore. Leaks have happened before and it never changed anything about the game.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: True. GTA V leaked tons of stuff before release and it still sold like crazy.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: The character info is what I'm most curious about. Two protagonists again, or just one?

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: I hope they go back to one strong protagonist. Three felt a bit like a gimmick in V.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I liked the three-character switching, it made the heists feel unique. Just give them better story arcs this time.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Honestly the heists were the best part of V. If they improve that part I'm happy.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: What worries me is the online mode. If it's a shark card machine again, I'm out.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Everyone says that and then plays 500 hours of it anyway.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Guilty.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Price is going to be another topic. If it's 80 or more, I'll wait for a sale.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: It's Rockstar. They won't discount it for years. You'll be waiting until 2030.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: The PC version is the real question. Last time we waited about two years after the console launch.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Probably the same this time. At least my PC will be ready by then.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: My laptop would need a miracle. I'll probably play on console and cry about the frame rate.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: 30 fps on launch I can survive, but 60 would be nice.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: Did anyone read the gameplay mechanics part? I'm interested in the NPC stuff.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: I read it. Take it with a grain of salt, but the NPC reactions sound like what RDR2 did, which would be amazing in a big city.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: RDR2-level detail in a modern city would be absurdly big. I'm not sure the hardware can handle it.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: Rockstar always finds a way. RDR2 looked impossible on the old consoles and they pulled it off.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: True. And if it keeps getting delayed it's because they're polishing it. I'll take that over a buggy launch.

comments.author: robert
comments.text: Agreed. Still, I'd like at least a release window. The silence is killing me.

comments.author: alvaro
comments.text: Same. Maybe we get a third trailer before the end of the year.

comments.author: martin
comments.text: In that case I'll be refreshing the Rockstar newswire like an idiot.

comments.author: daniel
comments.text: We'll all be here in the comments when it drops. See you then.
